slots.notes: Full-bleed autoplay/muted/loop background video filling each bento feature card (object-cover, 100% opacity, no overlay/tint); text sits above it. Card 01 is a tall portrait-ish cell (row-span-2, min-h-28rem), Card 02 is wide (col-span-2), Cards 03/04 are standard cells, so each clip is cropped to a different aspect.

mechanic: Static dark CSS-grid bento of feature cards, each a full-bleed autoplay looping video layered under relative-positioned text, with the only motion being a liquid-glass button hover scale to 1.02.
techDelivery: TanStack Start (route file src/routes/index.tsx) + Tailwind CSS v4 with tokens/global CSS in src/styles.css.
reskinNotes:
The liquid-glass button highlight is a hardcoded multi-stop white linear-gradient mask baked into the .liquid-glass::before CSS (not tokenized), so reskinning the accent means editing that gradient and its rgba stops by hand. The #252B4C card color lives in raw .feature-card/.feature-card-dark CSS rather than a Tailwind theme token, and the two card classes are intentionally identical despite the '-dark' suffix. All copy is hardcoded inline in the JSX markup, including manual
line breaks in headings and paragraphs, so copy edits require touching the route component, not data.
